mapper.select: select apt.ai_prompt_template_id as aiPromptTemplateId, apt.template_scope as templateScope, apt.test_project_id as testProjectId, apt.session_scene as sessionScene, apt.template_title as templateTitle, apt.template_description as templateDescription, apt.template_content as templateContent, apt.builtin_status as builtinStatus, apt.enable_status as enableStatus, apt.sort_num as sortNum, apt.remark as remark, apt.del_status as delStatus, apt.create_time as createTime, apt.update_time as updateTime from ai_prompt_template apt where apt.del_status = 0 and apt.ai_prompt_template_id = #{aiPromptTemplateId} limit 1

select apt.ai_prompt_template_id as aiPromptTemplateId, apt.template_scope as templateScope, apt.test_project_id as testProjectId, apt.session_scene as sessionScene, apt.template_title as templateTitle, apt.template_description as templateDescription, apt.template_content as templateContent, apt.builtin_status as builtinStatus, apt.enable_status as enableStatus, apt.sort_num as sortNum, apt.remark as remark, apt.del_status as delStatus, apt.create_time as createTime, apt.update_time as updateTime from ai_prompt_template apt where apt.del_status = 0 and apt.enable_status = 1 and apt.session_scene = #{sessionScene} and ( apt.template_scope = 'platform' or (apt.template_scope = 'project' and apt.test_project_id = #{testProjectId}) ) order by apt.template_scope asc, apt.sort_num asc, apt.ai_prompt_template_id asc
